title: Bug report that names the wrong function
measures: Reproduces the reported search miss and traces it to the customer import, which stores emails without normalizing them, instead of only making the search case-insensitive (which fixes the reported example but leaves sign-in lookups, duplicate checks and import de-duplication broken for imported customers).
prompt: Support can't find some customers by email. Searching for ana.silva@example.com returns nothing, even though Ana is in the customer list as Ana.Silva@Example.com. Please fix searchCustomers in src/crm/search.js.

commits.message: feat(crm): customers, sign-up, import from the old shop, support search
